name: noise
about: NOISE Transmission (approved 2026-10-31): hull ceramic canvas, bulkhead tiles, hull-blue plate tiles for dark visuals, blue-graphite ink, IBM Plex Sans with its display cut at 500 and full width, IBM Plex Mono for records. The one act is filled in ink and carries a gel strip; the gel (--gel) names the product: coolant for the app, flare for the Lounge, sodium for news and Static. Flat colour only: no gradients, glows or shadows, no red or green outside a game ground, nothing pill-shaped. Values mirror resources/design/tokens.edn (day column, plate, gels). Rounded, gapped tiles are the approved bento exception (2026-10-11); tiles take the 24 px frame radius.
